title: A failed or queued candidate opens as a blank 'ready' plate and still takes K/X
body:
## Summary
The cull tile and the comparison draw the same candidate two ways. The tile knows a candidate is failed / queued / generating and prints the forge's error; the Lightbox hard-codes it as 'ready', so a failed candidate opens to a wordless broken-file glyph with no error, and offers Keep/Reject on it. The window keys K/X/U also write verdicts onto such candidates that no tile ever shows.

## Description
CullGrid.tsx:387-389 derives the tile's state (deleted / failed / ready / generating / queued) and only surfaces a verdict when ready (`v = state === 'ready' ? verdict : undefined`); :429-431 prints `candidate.error` on a failed tile. Lightbox.tsx:215-217 passes `src={candidate.deleted ? undefined : fileUrl(...)}` and `state={candidate.deleted ? 'deleted' : 'ready'}` for EVERY candidate, so a failed or pending one requests a file that does not exist and falls to ui.tsx:343-348's wordless 'missing' glyph; `candidate.error` appears 0 times in Lightbox.tsx; the footer still renders VerdictButtons (:197) and the K/X/U listener (:105-133) has no readiness check. Enter opens any focused candidate (CullGrid.tsx:163-172) and the arrows walk `order`, which holds every candidate (FoundryView.tsx:277), so failed ones are reached in normal use. CullGrid.tsx:151-162 likewise applies K/X/U to the focused candidate whatever its state: FoundryView.tsx:290 excludes pending/failed from the counts and the tile hides the stamp, so the only visible effect is the SaveNote flashing 'saving / saved' for a verdict nobody can see.

## Flow
- Live or failed forge run; arrow onto a tile drawn FAILED with its error
- Press Enter: the comparison opens on a blank frame with an image-off glyph, no word, no error
- Press K: footer reads 'kept', a KEPT stamp sits on the blank frame; close: the tile shows nothing, the bar counts nothing, the save note says 'saved'

## Expected impact
The reason a candidate failed is readable where the curator looks closest, and verdict keys stop writing invisible state into the manifest.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - opening a failed candidate shows a blank picture with no reason, and K/X 'keep' it invisibly
Before: Lightbox: 1 hard-coded state ('ready' unless deleted), 0 renders of candidate.error, verdict controls on 4 non-ready states; CullGrid keys: 0 readiness checks
After: one shared state derivation drives tile and Lightbox; failed shows the error verbatim; verdict controls and K/X/U only on ready candidates
Method: probe - code read of both render paths; reproduced the branch: Lightbox.tsx:217 state literal vs CullGrid.tsx:388 derivation; grep -c 'error' app/foundry/Lightbox.tsx for candidate.error = 0
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/foundry/CullGrid.tsx:387-389 (tile state + `v = state === "ready" ? verdict : undefined`), :429-431 (tile prints candidate.error), :151-162 (K/X/U without readiness), :163-172 (Enter opens any focused); app/foundry/Lightbox.tsx:215-217 (`state={candidate.deleted ? "deleted" : "ready"}`), :105-133 (keys), :187-199 (VerdictButtons); app/foundry/ui.tsx:343-348 (404 -> wordless missing glyph); app/foundry/FoundryView.tsx:277 (order = all candidates), :290 (counts exclude pending/failed); lib/foundry/types.ts Candidate.error: string | null
verify: Export from app/foundry/CullGrid.tsx a pure `artStateOf(candidate: Candidate | undefined, working: boolean): ArtState` (the body of CullGrid.tsx:387-388) and use it in CandidateTile. Probe (imports from '@/app/foundry/CullGrid', as cull-keys.probe.spec.ts already does): {status:'failed'} -> 'failed', {status:'pending'} with working=false -> 'queued', working=true -> 'generating', {deleted:true} -> 'deleted', {status:'graded'} -> 'ready' - RED on HEAD (no export). Source ratchet in the same probe (stripComments): Lightbox.tsx contains `artStateOf(` and `candidate.error`, and no longer contains `: "ready"}`; CullGrid.tsx's K/X/U cases are guarded by a ready check (assert the switch body references `artStateOf(` or a `ready` predicate before onVerdict). Implement: Lightbox passes artStateOf(...) to Art, renders candidate.error verbatim when failed, and shows VerdictButtons / binds K/X/U only when ready. npm test; npm run typecheck.

title: A failed replica, transfer or source shows FAILED and its error is unreachable
body:
## Summary
On the Extract board a replica round or a transfer whose generation failed is drawn as a FAILED wash with nothing to open, and on the pre-style source wall a source that could not be read is captioned 'failed'. In all three the engine's error string exists in the manifest and is rendered nowhere.

## Description
ExtractBoard.tsx:463 `if (!round.file) return <Art alt={`r${round.n} failed`} state="failed" .../>` - not a button, no text; roundZoom (:70-84) would show `round.error` but returns null without a file (:71), so the reason is unreachable. :481 TransferThumb: the same for `transfer.error` (transferZoom :86-99 also needs a file). :231-233, the wall drawn before any style exists: the figcaption prints 'failed' and `s.error` is unused (the zoom with s.error at :323 exists only for members of an extracted style). The types carry all three: lib/foundry/extract/types.ts ExtractSource.error, ReplicaRound.error, Transfer.error (string | null). PAIR: the cull tile prints its candidate's error on the FAILED wash (CullGrid.tsx:429-431). CLAUDE.md: real errors explain themselves in full.

## Flow
- Extract run where a generator call fails for one round
- Board row: replica column shows a FAILED wash in that round's slot
- Click it: nothing (not a button). Enter: opens the best replica with pixels, not the failed one
- The reason the round failed is not on screen anywhere

## Expected impact
A curator can tell a quota error from a content refusal from a timeout before keeping or throwing a style whose replica column is half failures - and decide whether 'retry failed' is worth pressing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a failed round, transfer or source says FAILED and never says why
Before: 3 failure branches (round, transfer, source wall) render 0 characters of their error
After: 3 of 3 render the error verbatim under the wash (rose text-label, unclamped)
Method: probe - code read of the three branches against the manifest types; roundZoom/transferZoom null-return on missing file confirmed at :71 and :87
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/foundry/ExtractBoard.tsx:463 (RoundThumb failed branch, no error), :481 (TransferThumb failed branch, no error), :231-233 (source wall figcaption 'failed', s.error unused), :71 and :87 (zoom builders return null without a file), :323 (s.error shown only in a member zoom); lib/foundry/extract/types.ts ExtractSource.error / ReplicaRound.error / Transfer.error: string | null; app/foundry/CullGrid.tsx:429-431 (twin prints candidate.error)
verify: Probe first (source ratchet over app/foundry/ExtractBoard.tsx, stripComments): the statement guarded by `if (!round.file)` must reference `round.error`, the one guarded by `if (!transfer.file)` must reference `transfer.error`, and the source-wall figcaption block must reference `s.error` - RED on HEAD (0 of 3). Implement: in each failed branch render the Art plus `{x.error}` (no line clamp) when error is non-null; the wall's caption prints s.error in place of the bare 'failed'. GREEN; npm run check:type (text-label floor); photograph with pipeline/cx-capture.mjs on the foundry screen if a failed fixture run exists.

title: Dropping a GIF or a 61st image on the Extract well does nothing visible
body:
## Summary
The Extract upload well silently discards what it will not take: any file not PNG/JPEG/WebP, and everything past the 60th image. Re-choosing a file just removed from the preview also does nothing. The Library shelf, which takes the same kind of drop, names every refusal and clears its input for exactly the re-pick case.

## Description
ExtractView.tsx:589-594 `accept()` filters to /^image\/(png|jpeg|webp)$/ and `.slice(0, 60)`, dropping the rest with no trace; :634 the hidden input's onChange never resets `e.target.value`, so choosing the same file again (after removing it from the preview grid, :648) fires no change event. A drop of only GIFs or a PDF leaves the well exactly as it was. The constraint line (:639 'PNG / JPEG / WebP / up to 60') states the rule but nothing reports that it was applied. PAIR: app/library/assets/ShelfGallery.tsx:118-124 clears the input value with the reason spelled out ('a user who removed a plate and re-added it would press the button and watch nothing happen'), and useShelf.ts:351 + ShelfGallery.tsx:129-133 render `Not added - <names>` for refused files.

## Flow
- New extraction: drop 3 PNGs and 2 GIFs
- Preview shows 3; nothing names the 2 GIFs
- Remove one PNG from the preview, choose it again via the picker: nothing happens
- Drop 70 images: 60 appear, 10 vanish without a word

## Expected impact
The curator knows what the run will and will not contain before paying for it, and the picker works on the second try.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - files the well refuses vanish silently, and re-picking a removed file does nothing
Before: 3 refusal paths (type filter, 60 cap, same-file re-pick) with 0 visible outcomes
After: 3 of 3 visible: refused names listed in one amber note (the ShelfGallery spelling), input value cleared after each pick
Method: probe - code read of accept() and the input's onChange; compared with the shelf's upload path
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/foundry/ExtractView.tsx:589-594 (accept: type filter + slice(0, 60), no refusal record), :634 (input onChange without value reset), :639 (constraint line), :648 (remove from preview); app/library/assets/ShelfGallery.tsx:118-124 (value reset + reason), :129-133 (uploadNote render); app/library/assets/useShelf.ts:351 (`Not added - ${rejected.join(' / ')}`)
verify: Export from app/foundry/ExtractView.tsx a pure `acceptGallery(prev: File[], incoming: File[], cap = 60): { files: File[]; refused: string[] }` (refused = names of wrong-type files and of everything past the cap). Probe (Node 24 here; File is global): prev [] + [a.png(image/png), b.gif(image/gif)] -> files [a.png], refused ['b.gif']; prev of 59 PNGs + 3 PNGs -> 60 files, refused 2 names - RED on HEAD (no export). Source ratchet (stripComments): the file input's onChange assigns `.value = ""`, and NewRun renders the refused list. Implement with the ShelfGallery.tsx:129-133 amber note spelling (no explanatory sentence - the names and 'Not added' only). npm test; npm run typecheck; npm run check:narration.

title: Cull and Dojo tabs draw nothing while their lists load, or forever if they hang
body:
## Summary
Two of the four foundry tabs have no loading state for their run/cycle list: until the first response lands (or forever, if it never does) the Cull tab is an empty strip and the Dojo tab an empty rail beside an empty pane. The other two tabs, and both of these tabs' own detail panes, use the route's <Loading>.

## Description
FoundryView.tsx:375-393: with runs === null and no error, `noRuns` is false, so RunStrip renders with runs null (RunCards.tsx:84-88 maps nothing), and `pending` is null because no run is selected yet (:376) - the cull pane is blank. DojoView.tsx:246-276: cycles === null -> the rail shows only its label and the main column renders neither Loading (needs `selected`, :275) nor PickACycle (needs cycles, :276). Siblings: StylesShelf.tsx:130 `if (!cat) return <Loading label="reading the catalogue" />`; ExtractView renders its NewRun form at once; the detail loads use Loading at FoundryView.tsx:376, ExtractView.tsx:379, DojoView.tsx:275. The failure branch exists (error + retry), the zero branch exists (ForgeEmpty / DojoEmpty), the never-returns branch is a blank page.

## Flow
- Open /foundry on a slow or hung API
- Cull tab: station header, then nothing
- Switch to Dojo: label 'Cycles', then nothing
- Switch to Styles: 'reading the catalogue' with a spinner

## Expected impact
A slow or hung foundry API reads as working-on-it rather than as an empty or broken page.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - two tabs are blank while loading and stay blank if the request hangs
Before: 2 of 4 tabs render 0 elements in the list-loading/never-returns state
After: 4 of 4 tabs render <Loading> for an unanswered list
Method: probe - code read of the branch conditions for runs === null / cycles === null with no error
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/foundry/FoundryView.tsx:375-393 (noRuns false when runs null; RunStrip with null; pending null), :376; app/foundry/RunCards.tsx:84-88; app/foundry/DojoView.tsx:246 (empty only when cycles.length === 0), :275-276; app/foundry/StylesShelf.tsx:130 (sibling with Loading); app/foundry/ExtractView.tsx:379
verify: Probe first (source ratchet, stripComments): FoundryView.tsx has a branch on `runs === null` (with no runsError) that renders `<Loading`, and DojoView.tsx one on `cycles === null` (with no listError) that renders `<Loading` - RED on HEAD (count of `<Loading` per file: FoundryView 1, DojoView 1; expected 2 each). Implement: in FoundryView's `cull`, render `<Loading label="reading the runs" />` when runs === null && !runsError; in DojoView's main column, `<Loading label="reading the cycles" />` when cycles === null && !listError. GREEN; npm run typecheck.

title: Station figures read '…' forever when a list fails; their comment promises 'off'
body:
## Summary
The Pipeline header's own docstring says a list that cannot be read leaves its figure OFF rather than showing a misleading number. The code draws an ellipsis instead - the same glyph it draws while loading - so a failed Extract/Styles/Dojo read reads as 'still loading' for the life of the page.

## Description
plant.tsx:53-56 (usePlant): 'A list that cannot be read leaves its figure OFF rather than showing a zero - a zero meaning "we could not ask" is worse than nothing'. But the rejection handler is `const drop = () => undefined` (:67), applied to all three reads (:78, :79, :88), so on failure the list stays undefined, and PipelineHeader renders every figure as `{f.n ?? '…'}` (:279) - indistinguishable from the in-flight state; the station's status Dot also disappears (lines() returns null, :174-196). The cull station has the same shape for `runs` when FoundryView's list read fails (runs stays null). Comment as spec vs code: the figure is not off, it is a permanent 'loading'.

## Flow
- Foundry API answers the catalogue with 500
- Styles station: '… styles  … proven' with no dot
- It never changes; only opening the Styles tab shows the error

## Expected impact
A station whose source is down stops claiming to be loading; the header tells the truth at a glance, which is its whole job.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a station whose list failed to load shows a loading ellipsis forever
Before: failed read and in-flight read render identically (`…`) on 4 stations; usePlant records 0 failures
After: failed read omits the figure (the comment's 'off'), distinct from the in-flight ellipsis
Method: probe - code read: plant.tsx:67 drop handler + :279 fallback; comment :53-56 diffed against it
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/foundry/plant.tsx:53-56 (comment: figure OFF on failure), :67 `const drop = () => undefined`, :68-88 (three reads), :279 `{f.n ?? "…"}`, :164-196 (engine lines null when list undefined); app/foundry/FoundryView.tsx:228 (runs failure leaves runs null)
verify: usePlant records which reads failed (e.g. `failed: Partial<Record<'extract'|'catalogue'|'cycles', true>>` set in each rejection handler); PipelineHeader drops a figure whose source failed instead of rendering the ellipsis. Probe: source ratchet (stripComments) that plant.tsx's rejection handlers write a failure marker (no bare `() => undefined` for the three list reads) and that the `?? "…"` fallback is gated on not-failed. Lane B only because plant.tsx is not in this context's mapped file_paths (map drift, see coverage line).

lens_checked.visual-craft: Read in full: page.tsx, FoundryView.tsx, CullGrid.tsx, Lightbox.tsx, ExtractView.tsx, ExtractBoard.tsx, DojoView.tsx, StylesShelf.tsx, parts.tsx, plus the unmapped leaves they import: ui.tsx, plant.tsx, RunCards.tsx; signal README, Tally CHIP_CLASS/TALLY_TONE. Noted, not emitted (budget): 6 hand-rolled chips (`rounded border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.0x] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-label`) sit in the same rows as <Tally> chips with a different tracking/alpha - DojoView.tsx:286,290; ExtractView.tsx:551,696; StylesShelf.tsx:339,340 - a second spelling of CHIP_CLASS.
lens_checked.ux-reviewer: Commit flows (CommitDialog in-dialog failure, server plan token) on Cull and Extract; Dojo commit has no server plan/token (DojoView.tsx:229-244 vs FoundryView.tsx:301,314) - a parity/API item, not UI. CommandCard copy failure is swallowed silently (ui.tsx:650-657, `() => undefined`, and `navigator.clipboard?.` no-ops off a secure origin) while the audio workbench toasts 'clipboard blocked' - noted, ui.tsx is unmapped. Keyboard: Enter rule (activatesOnEnter) wired in CullGrid and ExtractBoard; StylesShelf arrows.
lens_checked.state-coverage: Per data source - runs/run detail/verdict save (FoundryView), extract runs/detail/drive/step (ExtractView), cycles/detail (DojoView), catalogue (StylesShelf), plant previews (plant.tsx): zero / failure / never-returns traced; findings 1, 2, 4, 5. Also: an empty catalogue renders only the 'all 0' pill row (StylesShelf.tsx:135-139), no empty state - noted.
lens_checked.copy-auditor: Status words (parts.tsx STATUS_WORD/EXTRACT_STATUS_WORD/DOJO_STATUS_WORD) vs chips; commit consequences (exempt destructive-confirm sentences) checked against the store: 'nothing was deleted' is true because lib/foundry/store.ts writes indices before unlinking (comment :237-240), except an unlink loop that throws mid-way (store.ts:280-282) - API-side, not emitted. 'thrown' (ExtractView.tsx:452) vs 'rejected' elsewhere for the same verdict - minor.
lens_checked.accessibility-checker: Noted, not emitted: CullGrid RowFragment uses role="rowheader" with no row/grid ancestor (CullGrid.tsx:341; the container is role=group via useRoving); station tabs (plant.tsx:255-299) have no aria-controls and the tabpanel is labelled by the raw id 'cull' (FoundryView.tsx:406); a verdict changed by K/X on a focused tile updates only aria-label, which is not announced (CullGrid.tsx:398). VerdictButtons, ScorePill/ScoreMeters sr-only text, Art sr-only alt, SaveNote live region checked and sound.

lens_no_surface.mobile-specialist: The /foundry curation surface is a desktop GPU-plant console (matrix grid, 2xl two-scene layout, keyboard-first); not plainly meant to work narrow.

map_drift: app/foundry/ui.tsx, plant.tsx, RunCards.tsx and styleArt.ts (added in the round-2/3 redesign, 2026-10-05) are not in this context's file_paths although every mapped surface imports them - finding 5 is Lane B only for that reason, and the chip/CommandCard notes would be too.
